describes: 'It Is Well with My Soul', a clean screenshot of a hymnal page rather than a photograph -- the sharpest input the app gets, and the fastest to read. Melody and bass staves, three verses stacked under the melody, and no chord symbols printed anywhere. The case that exercises chord suggestion rather than transcription. (Re-pointed 2026-10-20: the original upload is no longer in song-scans, so this fixture had been skipping silently for an unknown length of time.
